nodes.label: ADR 0169: The main DJ library
nodes.rationale: Establishes that one DJ library per computer is main; its grid and cues are song defaults after GLUE's own; two-way sync targets it; addresses need for consistent BPM and cues across imports

nodes.label: Main DJ library
nodes.rationale: One per computer on its record (Source.main); its grids and cues become song defaults after GLUE's own; target of two-way sync; marked via sidebar or Prepare

nodes.label: BPM hierarchy
nodes.rationale: Song BPM shown in order: GLUE's own correction, main DJ library's grid, analysis, then another DJ app; grid shown if GLUE's BPM matches main library's

nodes.label: Two-way sync
nodes.rationale: Planned phase 2 sync between GLUE and the main DJ library; opt-in per library; backup first, app closed
